traits.name: Coffin Boat
traits.descriptionHtml:
The ferryman rides an open coffin on a swell of swamp water, allowing it to travel with a Speed of 40 feet over any surface, including liquids, ignoring Difficult Terrain. The coffin can hold two other Medium creatures. Two Small creatures or four Tiny creatures count as one Medium creature.

While riding the coffin, the ferryman has Immunity to the Prone condition, and the coffin moves with the ferryman unless the ferryman has the Incapacitated condition. The coffin has AC 15; HP 25; Immunity to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage.

If the coffin is destroyed, the ferryman can magically create a new one using a 10-minute ritual.

While riding the coffin, the ferryman has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, and the coffin moves with the ferryman unless the ferryman has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. The coffin has AC 15; HP 25; {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage.
If the coffin is destroyed, the ferryman can magically create a new one using a 10-minute ritual.

If the creature or its allies damage the ferryman or force it to make a saving throw, this effect ends and the creature can't use that ferryman's Payment trait again.

If it takes Fire damage, it doesn't regain Hit Points at the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Devour Mind (1/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml:
The worm vanishes and magically enters the mind of a creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The worm can't target a creature under the effect of the Mind Blank or Protection from Evil and Good spells. While in the target's mind, the worm can't take actions, and the target experiences the worm appearing in its memories as it devours each one. At the end of each of the target's turns, it takes 88 (16d10) Psychic damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the target is Stable but loses all its memories permanently. Only a Wish spell can restore the lost memories.

Devour Mind ends if the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points and the worm appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of the target. Devour Mind can also be ended in the following ways:

  • As an action, the target mentally duels the worm and makes a DC 20 ability check using Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (its choice). On a success, the worm must succeed on a Charisma saving throw with a DC equal to the check's total or Devour Mind ends.
  • Devour Mind ends if the target receives an effect that ends possession, including the Dispel Evil and Good spell.
  • If the target takes damage, the worm takes Psychic damage equal to half that amount. It must succeed on a Charisma saving throw with a DC equal to the Psychic damage taken, or Devour Mind ends.

The region containing the Wild Titan's lair is changed by its presence, creating the following effects:

    Within 1 mile of the lair, there is a 75% chance every day of heavy precipitation.
